content:
{'text': '曾兩奪奧斯卡、四度封視后的Sally Field，在一場基本上與政治無關的艾美獎頒獎禮上，明顯地抨擊了Trump總統對加拿大的挑釁。', 'original': "Sally Field, a two-time Oscar winner and four-time Emmy winner, used what was largely an apolitical Emmy Awards ceremony to deliver a pointed rebuke of President Trump's provocations against Canada."}

{'text': '她在憑《Remarkably Bright Creatures》獲獎後，思緒隨即飄向北方。', 'original': 'After winning for "Remarkably Bright Creatures," her thoughts turned northward.'}

{'text': '她向攝影師Ashley Connor高喊：「她把太平洋西北部塑造成另一個角色，那就是加拿大！」', 'original': 'She shouted to cinematographer Ashley Connor, "She made the Pacific Northwest another character. That was Canada!"'}

{'text': '她語帶鋒芒地說：「蒙福的加拿大——我們的鄰居，我們的朋友」，現場觀眾報以熱烈掌聲，當中包括反Trump活躍分子Mark Ruffalo。', 'original': 'Then, pointedly, she added, "Blessed Canada — our neighbors, our friends," to thunderous applause from the crowd, which included anti-Trump activist Mark Ruffalo.'}

{'text': 'Trump在其第二任期內，大部分時間都在疏遠這個與美國接壤的盟友。他重新掀起貿易戰，更進一步在行政命令中將安大略湖改稱為「美洲湖」以火上加油。他亦多次揚言要把加拿大吞併，成成為美國第51個州。', 'original': 'Trump has spent much of his second term alienating the U.S.\'s neighbor to the north. He reignited a trade war, then poured fuel on the fire by renaming Lake Ontario as "Lake of the Americas" in an executive order. He\'s also repeatedly suggested annexing Canada as the 51st state.'}

{'text': '加拿大總理Carney表示：「我們知道美國正在改變——他們的貿易關係、外交政策、國家地標，以至地理名稱。加拿大人亦明白，為事物命名就是承認現實——它叫安大略湖，從前是，現在是，永遠都是。」', 'original': 'Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney said, "We know the United States is changing — their trade relationships, their foreign policy, their national landmarks and, indeed, their geographic names. Canadians also know that naming something is an acknowledgment of reality — it is called Lake Ontario. It was, it is, and it always will be."'}

{'text': '憑「有限劇集或選集劇集/電視電影最佳女主角」獲獎的Field，似乎同時在評論Paramount Skydance與華納兄弟之間一宗有待批准的合併。這項涉資1,100億美元的交易因遭加州及紐約等12個州提起訴訟而陷入僵步，憂慮交易會損害競爭。', 'original': 'Field, who won for Best Lead Actress in a Limited or Anthology Series or Movie, also appeared to be commenting on the pending merger between Paramount Skydance and Warner Bros. Discovery. The $110 billion deal has stalled over a lawsuit brought by 12 states, including California and New York, who fear it would harm competition.'}

{'text': 'Field說：「62年來，我一直很感恩、也很自豪能成為藝術界的一份子。有了藝術，我們的存在至關重要。我們的聲音至關重要。我們的多元、我們獨一無二的敘事方式至關重要。我們絕不能讓這些聲音被噤聲、被妥協、被合併。」', 'original': '"For 62 years, I have been grateful and proud to be a member of the artistic community," Field said. "With art, our presence matters. Our voices matter. Our diversity, our unique narratives matter. We cannot let those voices be silenced, compromised or merged."'}
